page.overview:
Who is Calis Krishtan?

Calis Krishtan was an entrepreneur from Ank'Harel who founded The Maiden's Wish casino in Kymal.

Around 766 PD, Calis moved to Kymal and opened a small casino called The Maiden's Wish, giving the rural city's stagnant economy a needed boost. As of 812 PD, Krishtan operated the casino and had a son, Jaktur Krishtan, margrave of Kymal and heir to The Maiden's Wish. By 836 PD, Jaktur had inherited the ownership of the casinos previously managed by his father.
